findings.passage: Pa. state Rep. Mary Isaacson stands with Moms Demand Action as they call on the state Senate to bring commonsense gun laws to a vote. findings.note: Requires state law enforcement to try to return recovered firearms to lawful owners and to destroy them if no owner is found in 120 days.
Requires all firearm purchases to be face-to-face at a licensed seller's business or county sheriff's office.
Requires background-check applications to be delivered in person to a State Police station, with a disability exception, and rejects incomplete ones with a 14-day wait.
Requires concealed carry permit applications to be submitted in person, with a disability exception and a 14-day wait after rejection.
Lets observers watch background-check processing at the State Police Instant Check Unit and carry-permit processing at county sheriff offices.
